description: Test support module for mocking and managing lifecycle of Zalo webhook monitor in a testing environment, including mock setup, module imports, and monitor startup functions.

methods.name: installLifecycleModuleMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock implementations for API and runtime modules.

methods.name: importMonitorModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the monitor module with optional mocking based on parameters.

methods.name: importSecretInputModule
methods.description: Imports the secret input module with cache busting.

methods.name: resetLifecycleTestState
methods.description: Clears mocks and resets webhook security state for testing.

methods.name: setLifecycleRuntimeCore
methods.description: Mocks the Zalo runtime with a specified channel.

methods.name: loadLifecycleMonitorModule
methods.description: Loads the monitor module with mocking enabled.

methods.name: startWebhookLifecycleMonitor
methods.description: Starts the webhook lifecycle monitor with provided account and configuration, returning control objects.
